messages.content:
Facilities sent next year's office closure calendar; it is in data/closures-2027.json.
Please teach bizdays to work with more than one calendar, and add a command for counting
business days:

- [calendar] in config/calendar.toml should accept sources, a list of calendar sources
  (file paths or URLs, like the single source value today). bizdays should load all of
  them, and a day is closed when any of them lists it. A source that cannot be loaded
  should stop the command with an error and exit status 2, as it does today.
- Change config/calendar.toml to list both data/closures.json and
  data/closures-2027.json, so that bizdays add and bizdays check respect the 2027
  closure days.
- Add bizdays between START END, which prints how many business days come after START
  up to and including END (so if bizdays add D N prints X, bizdays between D X prints
  N). When END is before START it should print an error and exit with status 2.

Configuration files that still use the single source key, and everything else that
works today, should keep working the same way.
